name: forest-admin-ai
description: AI skills and tools for Forest

plugins.name: forest
plugins.description: ★ Main plugin — build a Forest Admin back-office headlessly from Claude, no UI. Start with /forest:start. Covers onboarding, layout & workspaces, workflows, project management (roles/users/teams/environments/deploy), and self-hosting the agent in your own app or infrastructure. Orchestrates the toolbelt CLI end-to-end.

plugins.name: forest-code
plugins.description: Write and maintain Forest Admin agent code (modern + legacy): actions, fields, hooks, segments, charts, relationships. Pairs with `forest`.

plugins.name: forest-mcp
plugins.description: Skill for querying and manipulating Forest data through the Forest MCP server (list/search/create/update/delete records, explore schemas).

plugins.name: forest-docs
plugins.description: Ask anything about Forest: connects to the docs MCP server.
